name: A long turn and the quiet after it go through their tiers
case: Claude works on one turn for twenty minutes, then sits idle for ten. The board hears how long in its tags: a marathon from 8 minutes into the turn and a camp from 15; then, once the turn is over, fidgets from 30 seconds, a set piece from 3 minutes, and a doze from 10.
why: Core.when: the longest turn working's tier (Occasions.workTiers) and, with none working, the time since the last turn ended (Occasions.idleTiers), one tier at a time, in state.when (characters/CHARACTER.md §9)
